
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/greatsql/p/20905641" title="发布于 2026-06-29 08:51">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">参数引发的复制中断：max_binlog_cache_size 导致 SQL 线程异常的复现与分析</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="问题发生">问题发生</h1>
<p>某个客户的一套数据库，主库为 MySQL 5.7.44，从库为 GreatSQL 8.0.32-27，从库的 SQL 线程中断，报错如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-Plain">2026-05-07T21:53:42.151856+08:00 145 [ERROR] [MY-010584] [Repl] Slave SQL for channel '': Worker 1 failed executing transaction '18c68804-62e7-11f1-846e-00163ed55da5:3425315180' at master log binlog.022823, end_log_pos 127908803; Could not execute Write_rows event on table ort.bm_cdr; Writing one row to the row-based binary log failed, Error_code: 1534; handler error HA_ERR_RBR_LOGGING_FAILED; the event's master log FIRST, end_log_pos 627908803, Error_code: MY-001534
2026-05-07T21:53:42.245982+08:00 144 [Warning] [MY-010584] [Repl] Slave SQL for channel '': ... The slave coordinator and worker threads are stopped, possibly leaving data in inconsistent state. A restart should restore consistency automatically, although using non-transactional storage for data or info tables or DDL queries could lead to problems. In such cases you have to examine your data (see documentation for details). Error_code: MY-001756
</code></pre>
<p>报错信息表示：主库在回放事务 18c68804-62e7-11f1-846e-00163ed55da5:3425315180 时失败了，失败位置发生在执行 Write_rows 事件写入从库本地 row-based binlog 的过程中，最终导致 SQL 线程终止。</p>
<h1 id="问题排查">问题排查</h1>
<p>看到 <code>Could not execute Write_rows event on table</code>，容易误以为是表数据写入失败或数据冲突。</p>
<ul>
<li><code>Writing one row to the row-based binary log failed</code></li>
<li><code>Error_code: 1534</code></li>
<li><code>handler error HA_ERR_RBR_LOGGING_FAILED</code></li>
</ul>
<p>这说明故障与从库写本地 binlog 有关。该从库开启了本地 binlog，并记录复制回放产生的更新，即开启了 <code>log_slave_updates</code> / <code>log_replica_updates</code>。因此，SQL 线程不仅要把主库事务回放到表中，还要把该事务再次写入从库自己的 binlog；如果从库 binlog 事务缓存上限过小，就可能在回放大事务时失败。</p>
<p>对比主库和从库参数后，发现关键差异如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-Plain">主库 max_binlog_cache_size = 4G
从库 max_binlog_cache_size = 10M
</code></pre>
<p>主库允许生成较大的事务 binlog，而从库写本地 binlog 时只允许最多使用 10M 的事务缓存。将从库 <code>max_binlog_cache_size</code> 调整为与主库一致后，再启动 SQL 线程，复制恢复正常。</p>
<p>随后使用 <code>mysqlbinlog</code> 解析故障 GTID 对应的 binlog，并与业务侧确认，该 GTID 确实是一个大事务，事务产生的 binlog 体量远超从库 10M 的 <code>max_binlog_cache_size</code> 限制。</p>
<p>我们知道，通常当<code>max_binlog_cache_size</code>设置过小时，会有 Error_code: MY-001197 的报错，那什么时候会出现仅有 Error_code: MY-001534 的报错呢？本文整理复现过程如下。</p>
<h1 id="实验验证">实验验证</h1>
<h2 id="测试环境参数配置">测试环境参数配置</h2>
<p>搭建主从异步复制环境，主库端参数配置如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-Plain">binlog_cache_size                              =32768
max_binlog_cache_size                          =4294967296  #4G
max_binlog_size                                =1073741824
binlog_row_image                               =FULL
binlog_rows_query_log_events                   =ON
</code></pre>
<p>从库端参数配置如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-Plain">binlog_cache_size                              =32768
max_binlog_cache_size                          =10485760   #10M
max_binlog_size                                =1073741824
binlog_row_image                               =FULL
binlog_rows_query_log_events                   =ON
log_replica_updates                            =ON
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<p>复现该问题的关键前提是：从库开启本地 binlog，并记录复制回放的更新。如果从库不写本地 binlog，通常不会在 SQL 线程回放时触发本地 <code>max_binlog_cache_size</code> 限制。</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="创建测试表">创建测试表</h2>
<p>在主库创建测试表并插入数据</p>
<pre><code class="language-SQL">mysql&gt; CREATE TABLE test.t1 (id INT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, c2 VARCHAR(255), c3 VARCHAR(255), c4 VARCHAR(255), c5 VARCHAR(255));
mysql&gt; INSERT INTO test.t1 VALUES (NULL, REPEAT('a', 250), REPEAT('b', 250), REPEAT('c',250), REPEAT('d', 250));
-- 持续执行如下语句14次
mysql&gt; INSERT INTO test.t1 (c2,c3,c4,c5) SELECT c2,c3,c4,c5 FROM t1;
mysql&gt; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test.t1;
+----------+
| count(*) |
+----------+
|    16384 |
+----------+
1 row in set (0.04 sec)
</code></pre>
<h3 id="实验一单语句大事务触发错误-1197--1534">实验一：单语句大事务触发错误 1197 + 1534</h3>
<p>主库执行如下<code>INSERT</code>语句，插入10319条数据，这时产生的 binlog 未超过从库<code>max_binlog_cache_size=10M</code>的限制，查看主从复制状态没有异常，且主从数据一致。</p>
<pre><code class="language-SQL">mysql&gt; INSERT INTO test.t1 (c2,c3,c4,c5) SELECT c2,c3,c4,c5 FROM t1 LIMIT 10319;
Query OK, 10319 rows affected (0.62 sec)
Records: 10319  Duplicates: 0  Warnings: 0
</code></pre>
<p>主库执行如下<code>INSERT</code>语句，插入10320条数据，这时产生的binlog已经超过从库<code>max_binlog_cache_size=10M</code>的限制。</p>
<pre><code class="language-SQL">mysql&gt; INSERT INTO  test.t1 (c2,c3,c4,c5) SELECT c2,c3,c4,c5 FROM t1 LIMIT 10320;
Query OK, 10320 rows affected (0.62 sec)
Records: 10320  Duplicates: 0  Warnings: 0
</code></pre>
<p>再次查看主从复制状态，SQL 线程已经异常终止，error.log 中打印错误信息如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-Plain">2026-06-10T11:19:02.366583+08:00 212 [ERROR] [MY-010584] [Repl] Slave SQL for channel '': Worker 1 failed executing transaction '18c68804-62e7-11f1-846e-00163ed55da5:85' at master log binlog.000001, end_log_pos 755113733; Could not execute Write_rows event on table test.t1; Multi-statement transaction required more than 'max_binlog_cache_size' bytes of storage; increase this mysqld variable and try again, Error_code: 1197; Writing one row to the row-based binary log failed, Error_code: 1534; handler error HA_ERR_RBR_LOGGING_FAILED; the event's master log binlog.000001, end_log_pos 755113733, Error_code: MY-001197
2026-06-10T11:19:02.548790+08:00 211 [Warning] [MY-010584] [Repl] Slave SQL for channel '': ... The slave coordinator and worker threads are stopped, possibly leaving data in inconsistent state. A restart should restore consistency automatically, although using non-transactional storage for data or info tables or DDL queries could lead to problems. In such cases you have to examine your data (see documentation for details). Error_code: MY-001756
</code></pre>
<p>可以看到错误日志中明确提示<code>max_binlog_cache_size</code>过小，错误码为1197+1534。此时调大<code>max_binlog_cache_size</code>再 START SLAVE 问题即可解决。</p>
<h3 id="实验二多语句事务只暴露错误-1534">实验二：多语句事务只暴露错误 1534</h3>
<p>在主库开启事务，依次执行以下语句：</p>
<pre><code class="language-SQL">mysql&gt; BEGIN;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.00 sec)

mysql&gt; INSERT INTO  test.t1 (c2,c3,c4,c5) SELECT c2,c3,c4,c5 FROM t1 LIMIT 10319;
Query OK, 10319 rows affected (0.25 sec)
Records: 10319  Duplicates: 0  Warnings: 0

mysql&gt; INSERT INTO  test.t1 VALUES (NULL, 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa', 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa', 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa', 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa');
Query OK, 1 row affected (0.00 sec)

mysql&gt; COMMIT;
Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.06 sec)
</code></pre>
<p>此时观察从库主从复制状态，显示 SQL 线程状态异常，error.log 中信息如下，可以看到，只有1534报错码，没有提示<code>max_binlog_cache_size</code>过小的信息。</p>
<pre><code class="language-Plain">2026-06-10T11:34:24.333342+08:00 232 [ERROR] [MY-010584] [Repl] Slave SQL for channel '': Worker 1 failed executing transaction '18c68804-62e7-11f1-846e-00163ed55da5:86' at master log binlog.000001, end_log_pos 771775512; Could not execute Write_rows event on table test.t1; Writing one row to the row-based binary log failed, Error_code: 1534; handler error HA_ERR_RBR_LOGGING_FAILED; the event's master log FIRST, end_log_pos 771775512, Error_code: MY-001534
2026-06-10T11:34:24.537353+08:00 231 [Warning] [MY-010584] [Repl] Slave SQL for channel '': ... The slave coordinator and worker threads are stopped, possibly leaving data in inconsistent state. A restart should restore consistency automatically, although using non-transactional storage for data or info tables or DDL queries could lead to problems. In such cases you have to examine your data (see documentation for details). Error_code: MY-001756
</code></pre>
<h2 id="实验结论">实验结论</h2>
<p>以上两种情况，都是由于从库端<code>max_binlog_cache_size</code>设置过小导致SQL线程异常终止。前者是批量插入，binlog Event 总量超过 <code>max_binlog_cache_size</code> 限制时，数据库会抛出明确的 1197 错误（缓存超限），并伴随 1534 错误（单行写入失败）。</p>
<p>后者是最后一个单行插入语句生成的 Row Event 过大，超出了当前 binlog Cache 剩余可用空间，导致这一行无法写入，从而仅触发 1534 错误。虽然 error.log 记录的信息不同，但都属于同一故障。</p>
<h1 id="总结">总结</h1>
<ol>
<li><strong>从库也会受 binlog cache 限制。</strong> 只要从库开启本地 binlog 并记录复制更新，SQL 线程回放事务时就要写本地 binlog，因此会受从库 <code>max_binlog_cache_size</code> 限制。</li>
<li><strong><code>1534</code></strong>** 不是数据冲突。** 当日志中出现 <code>Writing one row to the row-based binary log failed</code> 和 <code>HA_ERR_RBR_LOGGING_FAILED</code> 时，应优先检查 row-based binlog 写入链路，包括 <code>max_binlog_cache_size</code>、磁盘空间、临时目录、本地 binlog 配置等。</li>
<li><strong>主库和从库关键参数应保持基线一致。</strong> 尤其是 <code>max_binlog_cache_size</code>、<code>binlog_format</code>、<code>binlog_row_image</code>、<code>max_allowed_packet</code>、<code>lower_case_table_names</code> 等会影响复制兼容性或回放行为的参数，建议在变更前后做自动化比对。</li>
<li><strong>大事务是根因风险。</strong> 调大 <code>max_binlog_cache_size</code> 可以恢复复制，但不能消除大事务带来的 binlog 膨胀、复制延迟、回滚成本、备份恢复耗时等问题。批量 DML 应尽量拆分成小事务分批提交。</li>
<li><strong>不要混淆 <strong><strong><code>max_binlog_cache_size</code></strong></strong> 和 <strong><strong><code>max_binlog_size</code></strong></strong>。</strong> 前者限制单事务写 binlog 可使用的缓存上限，后者只是 binlog 文件滚动的期望大小。一个大事务不会被拆到多个 binlog 文件中。</li>
<li><strong>阈值不要照搬。</strong> 本文中 10319/10320 行只是当前表结构、字符集、row image、binlog 配置和版本组合下的临界点。换成其他表结构或参数后，临界点会变化。</li>
</ol>
